method: Contact sheets for every frame; 1568px view of all 56 candidates (swimmer excluded); 100% crops on 19 subjects. Instagram checked: post C-QkS-AIht6 (4 Aug 2024) is 6390, 6417-2, 6430.

frames.technical: window reflections from the cable car glass across the sky
frames.critique: The lighthouse is a nice anchor, but the reflections only show at full size and spoil a frame that is mostly sky.
Weaker twin of 4871.
Bay at sunset, less shape than 4893.
The YEOSU sign in silhouette is a postcard gimmick; the sign is the subject, not the place.
The best of the bay sunsets: hills layered against the sun.
Near-twin of 4893.
Pink dusk on the Dolsan bridge with the red bus; good, a step behind 4953.

frames.focus: sharp (crop on the pylons and deck: cables and cars crisp)
frames.critique: The best frame of Yeosu. Lit pylons against blue hour, the city behind. Holds up at 100%.
Expo area at blue hour; nothing to hold the eye.
A café front; a snapshot.

frames.technical: reflections of the cable car interior in the glass
frames.critique: Harbour at night, but shot through glass and it shows.
Pink sunrise over the harbour; pleasant colour, the hotel block is a heavy silhouette.
Twin of 4969 with less colour.
Odongdo path, a record.
Up a star: at full size the azaleas are crisp and the pink is clean. A real flower frame, not filler.
Path, a record.

frames.focus: pines a touch soft, focus on the far shore
frames.critique: Pine-framed skyline; works at display size, the framing branches are slightly soft at 100%.
Graphic concrete corridor; symmetric and calm. The empty upper half is a lot of flat sky.
Up a star: the hydrangeas are crisp, layered with the backlit leaves in front and the pines behind.

frames.focus: sharp island; foreground leaves out of focus
frames.critique: The blurred leaves at the corners read as an accident, not framing; the haze flattens the island.

frames.technical: sensor dust spot in the sky (visible at display size)
frames.critique: Strong: dancheong hall under the rock outcrop. Needs the dust cloned out before it ships.

frames.focus: sharp (crop on the carved phoenix: crisp)
frames.critique: Eaves framing the sea; the reason Hyangiram is a chapter.
Sea through trees, flat sky.
Tree framing the bay and its boats; the railing at the bottom is busy but honest.

frames.technical: large sensor dust spot top left, visible at display size
frames.critique: A haze coastline that adds nothing to 5032; and the dust spot is a defect on the live site today.
Rays over the river from the deck, people at the bottom; good sky, the people are cut and lit flat.
Crepuscular rays over Namsan; dramatic and earns its place.
The tower in golden haze with trains on the bridge and paddleboarders; a complete frame and a right opener.
Third tower silhouette in a row, and the white floating box in the middle is a distraction.
Towers against Bukhansan; a good contrast of old and new.
Picnic lawn under a big sky; strong sky, the lawn is a lot of flat foreground.
Picnics between two trees, the tower centred; the road takes the bottom third.
Busy: walkers scattered, the sun lost in haze. A snapshot of the evening, not a photo of it.
Lone figure and kayak with the sun on the bridge; good, but 6390 and 6427 tell the same story better.
The couple photographing, landscape; 6390 is the better framing of the moment.

frames.focus: soft at 100% on the couple (likely a near miss or slight shake); fine at display size
frames.critique: Posted cover. The moment is right, the sun centred between arches. At print size the softness would show.
Second edit, nearly identical.
Bridge run.
Up a star: the kayaker sits in the sun's path under the arch. The cleanest graphic frame of the evening.
Wide bridge with Yeouido and the kayak; good establishing frame, too many elements to be a hero.
Bridge run.
My pick. The full sun above the arch; heavy orange, nearly a twin of 6417-2 which was the one posted.
Uncropped edit of the posted frame.
The posted version (4:5, slide 2). Pass 1 rated it 1★ as a duplicate, which was wrong: a second edit can be the preferred one.
Two people photographing the sun, Yeouido behind; good, one of several.
Bridge run.

frames.focus: bridge sharp; figure soft behind the grass, intended
frames.critique: Posted. The sun sitting under the arch and a figure in the grass; the peak of the evening.
Sun at the pier, clean; the fifth bridge-and-sun frame.
Yeouido against pink; the after-sunset turn.
Twin of 6442.

frames.focus: sharp (crop on the glass grid: crisp)
frames.critique: Up a star: the 63 Building's gold glass against pink, a strong architectural frame that closes the evening.
Yeouido closer; between 6442 and 6449 and needed by neither.
Twin of 6442.
